mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_COLLECTION.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO COLLECTION ( COLLECTION_ID, MEMBER_ID, TITLE, DESCRIPTION, IS_PUBLIC, CREATED_DT ) VALUES ( #{collectionId}, #{memberId}, #{title}, #{description,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, NVL(#{isPublic,jdbcType=CHAR}, 'Y'), SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT C.COLLECTION_ID, C.MEMBER_ID, C.TITLE, C.DESCRIPTION, C.IS_PUBLIC, TO_CHAR(C.CREATED_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATED_DT, TO_CHAR(C.UPDATED_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS UPDATED_DT, M.NICKNAME, NVL(CI.ITEM_COUNT, 0) AS ITEM_COUNT, NVL(CL.LIKE_COUNT, 0) AS LIKE_COUNT, NVL(UC.COMMENT_COUNT, 0) AS COMMENT_COUNT FROM COLLECTION C INNER JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_ID = C.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COLLECTION_ID, COUNT(*) AS ITEM_COUNT FROM COLLECTION_ITEM GROUP BY COLLECTION_ID ) CI ON CI.COLLECTION_ID = C.COLLECTION_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COLLECTION_ID, COUNT(*) AS LIKE_COUNT FROM COLLECTION_LIKE GROUP BY COLLECTION_ID ) CL ON CL.COLLECTION_ID = C.COLLECTION_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COLLECTION_ID, COUNT(*) AS COMMENT_COUNT FROM USER_COMMENT WHERE COLLECTION_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY COLLECTION_ID ) UC ON UC.COLLECTION_ID = C.COLLECTION_ID WHERE C.COLLECTION_ID = #{collectionId}
mapper.update: UPDATE COLLECTION SET TITLE = #{title}, DESCRIPTION = #{description,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, IS_PUBLIC = #{isPublic}, UPDATED_DT = SYSDATE WHERE COLLECTION_ID = #{collectionId}
mapper.select:
SELECT COLLECTION_ID, MEMBER_ID, TITLE, DESCRIPTION, IS_PUBLIC, CREATED_DT, UPDATED_DT, NICKNAME, ITEM_COUNT, LIKE_COUNT, COMMENT_COUNT FROM ( SELECT C.COLLECTION_ID, C.MEMBER_ID, C.TITLE, C.DESCRIPTION, C.IS_PUBLIC, TO_CHAR(C.CREATED_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATED_DT, TO_CHAR(NVL(C.UPDATED_DT, C.CREATED_DT), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS UPDATED_DT, M.NICKNAME, NVL(CI.ITEM_COUNT, 0) AS ITEM_COUNT, NVL(CL.LIKE_COUNT, 0) AS LIKE_COUNT, NVL(UC.COMMENT_COUNT, 0) AS COMMENT_COUNT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY NVL(C.UPDATED_DT, C.CREATED_DT) DESC, C.COLLECTION_ID DESC ) AS RNUM FROM COLLECTION C INNER JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_ID = C.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COLLECTION_ID, COUNT(*) AS ITEM_COUNT FROM COLLECTION_ITEM GROUP BY COLLECTION_ID ) CI ON CI.COLLECTION_ID = C.COLLECTION_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COLLECTION_ID, COUNT(*) AS LIKE_COUNT FROM COLLECTION_LIKE GROUP BY COLLECTION_ID ) CL ON CL.COLLECTION_ID = C.COLLECTION_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COLLECTION_ID, COUNT(*) AS COMMENT_COUNT FROM USER_COMMENT WHERE COLLECTION_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY COLLECTION_ID ) UC ON UC.COLLECTION_ID = C.COLLECTION_ID
)
WHERE RNUM BETWEEN ((#{pageNo} - 1) * #{pageSize} + 1) AND (#{pageNo} * #{pageSize})
ORDER BY RNUM
